Implemented a 3.5-mile geofence, a 50-request local daily counter, and retry with degraded fallback for external data failures.
Built an automated pytest validation suite covering the MarketMind screening pipeline.
Reviewed 500+ user cases weekly against platform policy, identifying violations and behavioral patterns across structured and unstructured data.
Tracked and categorized enforcement decisions for trend analysis and consistency, collaborating across policy, operations, and analytics teams.

Automated mapping of self-report form responses into an evidence log and synchronized approved updates into an adoption tracker with approval-sync audit logging.
Documented pilot and UAT results across ten PASS test rows covering import validation, PII checks, applicability checks, and related scenarios.

Built a seven-screen beginner investing journey covering market information, allocation across four sectors, calculated results, and a sealed-bid property auction.
Kept official financial and auction calculations in a separate tested engine, so the interface only displays engine results.
Added validation for investment allocations and property bids, with 32/32 Vitest unit/calculation tests and 6/6 Playwright browser tests passing.
Tracked work through GitHub issues and reviewed pull requests; the demo was approved for presentation by the project team and course professor.
